user.title: Sign in to AcegasApsAmga
user.description: Use the email and password of the AcegasApsAmga Servizi Online.

contratti.title: Choose the contracts
contratti.description: Choose the contracts to follow (water, gas, electricity, district heating, waste). Each contract becomes a device with sensors, calendar and statistics.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: AcegasApsAmga rejected the sign-in of {email}. Enter the current credentials.

error.credenziali_non_valide: AcegasApsAmga rejected the email or password: {messaggio}
error.passaggio_inatteso: After the password AcegasApsAmga asks for another step ({messaggio}). Sign in once on the Servizi Online website, complete what it asks, then try again here.
error.impossibile_connettersi: Cannot reach AcegasApsAmga. Check the internet connection.

abort.nessun_contratto: The account has no supported contracts. Services found: {servizi}.
abort.account_diverso: You signed in with a different AcegasApsAmga account.

init.title: Contracts
init.description: Choose the contracts to follow. Removing a contract keeps the statistics already imported.

abort.credenziali_non_valide: AcegasApsAmga rejected the email or password: {messaggio}
abort.passaggio_inatteso: AcegasApsAmga asks for another step after the password ({messaggio}). Complete it on the Servizi Online website.
abort.impossibile_connettersi: Cannot reach AcegasApsAmga. Check the internet connection.

password_in_scadenza.title: AcegasApsAmga password expiring soon ({email})
password_in_scadenza.description: The Servizi Online password for {email} expires on {scadenza} ({giorni} days left). Update it on the AcegasApsAmga portal before it expires, then update your credentials in Home Assistant.

nuove_condizioni.title: New portal terms require acceptance ({email})
nuove_condizioni.description: The Servizi Online portal requires accepting updated terms for {email}. Sign in to the portal to accept them so the integration keeps working.

servizio_senza_autolettura.message: The {servizio} service does not support self-reading submission.

autolettura_valore_mancante.message: Provide 'valore' (or 'f1', 'f2', 'f3' for a multi-band electricity meter).

autolettura_inferiore.message: The portal rejected the self-reading (code 692): value is lower than the previous reading.

autolettura_fuori_finestra.message: The portal rejected the self-reading (code 695): the contract is outside its self-reading window.

nessuna_bolletta.message: No bill available for this contract.

percorso_non_valido.message: Invalid path ({percorso}): must be a .pdf file inside Home Assistant's config directory.

configura_energy_dashboard.name: Configure Energy dashboard
configura_energy_dashboard.description: Adds water, gas and electricity consumption of every configured contract to the Energy dashboard. Existing sources are left unchanged.

invia_autolettura.name: Submit self-reading
invia_autolettura.description: Submits a meter self-reading (water, gas, district heating, or mono/multi-band electricity) to AcegasApsAmga Servizi Online.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Meter device to submit the reading for (optional if only one contract is configured).

contratto.name: Contract number
contratto.description: Alternative to device: the contract identifier.

valore.name: Reading value
valore.description: Meter value for water, gas, district heating, or mono-band electricity (F0).

f1.name: Band F1
f1.description: Band F1 reading for a multi-band electricity meter (kWh).

f2.name: Band F2
f2.description: Band F2 reading for a multi-band electricity meter (kWh).

f3.name: Band F3
f3.description: Band F3 reading for a multi-band electricity meter (kWh).

scarica_bolletta.name: Download bill PDF
scarica_bolletta.description: Downloads a bill PDF (latest bill by default) into Home Assistant's config directory.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Contract device to download the bill for (optional if only one contract is configured).

contratto.name: Contract number
contratto.description: Alternative to device: the contract identifier.

numero.name: Bill number
numero.description: Bill number to download. Defaults to the latest bill.

dettaglio.name: Detailed PDF
dettaglio.description: Download the detailed bill PDF (v2 endpoint).

percorso.name: Target path
percorso.description: Destination .pdf path inside Home Assistant's config directory (default: www/acegasapsamga/bolletta_NUMBER.pdf).
